title: Procedural Spider Leg Placement System
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js (via CDN) that implements a procedural spider leg placement (inverse kinematics) system on uneven terrain.

## Scene Setup
- Dark ground plane (40x40 units) with procedural height variation: use sine/cosine waves to create gentle hills (amplitude ~0.5, frequency ~0.3). The ground should be a mesh with enough subdivisions (64x64) so vertices can be sampled for height.
- Camera: PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 8, 12) looking at origin. OrbitControls enabled.
- Lighting: one DirectionalLight (intensity 0.9, position 5,10,5), one AmbientLight (intensity 0.3), and a subtle HemisphereLight (sky: 0x8888ff, ground: 0x443322, intensity 0.2).
- Background color: 0x1a1a2e.

## Spider Body
- The spider body is an ellipsoid (SphereGeometry scaled to (1.2, 0.5, 0.8)) colored 0x2a2a2a, hovering ~1.2 units above the terrain surface.
- The body has 8 legs arranged symmetrically: 4 on each side. Leg attachment points (hip joints) are distributed along the body's sides at z-offsets [-0.5, -0.17, 0.17, 0.5] relative to body center, x-offset ±0.6.
- Each leg consists of 3 segments (hip-to-knee, knee-to-ankle, ankle-to-foot) rendered as thin cylinders or lines. Segment lengths: 0.8, 1.0, 0.6 units respectively.

## Procedural Leg IK & Stepping
- Each leg has a target foot position on the ground and a current foot position. When the distance between the target and the ideal rest position (projected outward from the hip) exceeds a step threshold (1.2 units), the leg initiates a step.
- Stepping animation: the foot lifts in an arc (0.4 units above ground) and lands at the new target over 0.3 seconds using smooth interpolation (ease-in-out).
- Legs step in an alternating gait pattern: legs are grouped into two sets (indices 0,3,5,6 and 1,2,4,7). Only one group steps at a time. A leg in one group cannot begin stepping if any leg in the other group is mid-step.
- IK solver: use a simple FABRIK or analytical 3-segment IK to position each leg's joints so the foot reaches the ground target while the hip stays attached to the body.

## Movement & Controls
- W/A/S/D keys move the spider body forward/left/backward/right relative to world axes at speed 2.0 units/sec.
- Q/E keys rotate the spider body left/right at 1.5 rad/sec.
- Spacebar toggles pause/resume of the entire animation system.
- The body should smoothly adjust its height to hover 1.2 units above the average ground height under its 8 foot positions.
- Arrow Up/Down keys adjust the spider's hover height by ±0.1 (clamped between 0.6 and 2.0).

## HUD / UI
- A DOM overlay panel (top-left, semi-transparent dark background, white text, id='hud') showing:
  - Current spider position (x, z) rounded to 2 decimals
  - Number of legs currently mid-step
  - Current hover height setting
  - Current gait group active (0 or 1)
  - Paused state (YES/NO)
- A button with id='btn-reset' that resets the spider to origin, rotation=0, default hover height=1.2, unpaused.
- A button with id='btn-toggle-debug' that toggles visibility of debug spheres (small red spheres at each foot target position, small green spheres at each actual foot position).

## State Management
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with these fields updated every frame:
- bodyPosition: {x, y, z} — spider body world position
- bodyRotation: number — Y-axis rotation in radians
- hoverHeight: number — current hover height setting
- legs: array of 8 objects, each with:
  - footPosition: {x, y, z} — current foot world position
  - targetPosition: {x, y, z} — current target world position
  - isStepping: boolean
  - stepProgress: number (0-1, 0 if not stepping)
  - segmentLengths: [number, number, number]
- activeGaitGroup: number (0 or 1)
- legsSteppingCount: number
- paused: boolean
- debugVisible: boolean
- totalStepsTaken: number — cumulative counter of completed steps
- frameCount: number — incremented each animation frame
- groundHeightAtBody: number — terrain height directly under body center
- bodyHeightAboveGround: number — actual distance from body to ground
- ikConverged: boolean — true if all legs have valid IK solutions (no NaN in joint positions)
physics_constraints: Body height must track terrain + hover offset within ±0.15 tolerance. All foot positions must lie on or very near the ground surface (y within ±0.1 of terrain height at that xz). IK joint positions must never contain NaN. Gait constraint: legs in different gait groups must not step simultaneously. Step arc must lift foot above ground during mid-step. Total segment reach per leg is 2.4 units; foot targets beyond this distance must be clamped.
